description: This file defines the class AM_ProjectTemplatesListViewData, which extends ListViewData, and provides a method getAdditionalDetailsAjax for retrieving additional record details via AJAX in a SuiteCRM project. It sets up some HTML snippets and a method for AJAX interactions, serving as a data handler for list view in the context of project templates.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesListViewData
classes.description: A data class extending ListViewData, providing AJAX detail retrieval for project templates list view.

methods.name: getAdditionalDetailsAjax
methods.description: Generates an HTML snippet with icons and a span that triggers a redirect to the detail view of a specific record via AJAX.
